title: Open Source Play Store app manifest

id.description: URL slug for the app page. Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes only. Must match the filename (id.json).

tagline.description: One short, friendly sentence saying what the app does.

description.description: Longer plain-text description. Blank lines separate paragraphs.

repo.description: URL of the public source repository, e.g. https://github.com/owner/name (no trailing slash or .git).

category.description: One category from the fixed taxonomy in data/categories.json.

license.description: SPDX license identifier, e.g. GPL-3.0, Apache-2.0, MIT.

icon.description: Optional https URL of a square app icon. If omitted, the repo owner's avatar is used.

screenshots.description: Optional https URLs of screenshots (phone portrait preferred).

website.description: Optional https URL of the app's homepage.

fdroid.description: Optional F-Droid package id (e.g. org.videolan.vlc). Used to offer a direct APK download when the GitHub release has none.

download.description: Optional https URL of an official download page or direct APK. Used when the latest GitHub release has no .apk asset.

added.description: Date the listing was added, YYYY-MM-DD. Filled automatically when publishing.

antiFeatures.description: Optional honest self-disclosure of things privacy-minded users want to know about.

status.description: Optional. Set to "testing" while the app is an early version so listings show an 'In testing' badge. Remove it once the app is stable. (Prerelease-style release tags are badged automatically.)
